page.overview:
Who is Florian Fortescue?

Florean Fortescue (d. 1996) was a British wizard and the owner of Florean Fortescue's Ice Cream Parlour in Diagon Alley. He was an expert on the subject of medieval witch-burnings. In the summer of 1996 he was abducted and later murdered by Lord Voldemort.

During the summer of 1993, when Harry Potter stayed at the Leaky Cauldron for a couple of weeks, Florean gave Harry free ice cream sundaes every half hour and helped him complete his History of Magic homework on the medieval witch-burnings, which may mean that he did well in his History of Magic classes.

In 1996, Florean was forcibly dragged away by Death Eaters, leaving his ice cream parlour a mess. Florean knew information about the Elder Wand and the lost diadem of Rowena Ravenclaw, so Voldemort captured, tortured, and later murdered him. The reason for his kidnapping did not become public knowledge; Bill Weasley speculated that he might have done something to provoke the anger of the Death Eaters.

Fortescue was a good-natured and generous individual, given how he kindly gave Harry Potter free ice cream and helped him complete his History of Magic homework in 1993, while he was staying in Diagon Alley. He was also highly intelligent, as he had considerable knowledge of Medieval witch-burnings, which allowed him to share his knowledge of this subject with Harry Potter. Furthermore, he seemed to be an opponent of Lord Voldemort and his Death Eaters, meaning he was possibly a supporter of the Order of the Phoenix, although this is unconfirmed.
